steps.text: Go down the ramp into the cellar south-west of Edron castle.
steps.source: Go down into the Edron Orc Cave. The entrance is southwest of the castle (Mapper Coords 129.149, 124.156, 7).

steps.text: Pull the lever if the stones block the way into the orc cave.
steps.source: You can access this area through a drain in the basement of the Edron Flats. (On the 7.1 map the cellar has a lever and stones that close the way.)

steps.text: Follow the cave west and south and go down (orcs, orc spearmen, orc warriors, poison spiders).
steps.source: Once in the hole, you will meet only Poison Spiders, Orcs, Orc Spearmen and Orc Warriors. Follow the cave to the west and then south.

steps.text: Go west, take the passage north and drop down the hole in the first room on the east.
steps.source: Go west and take the passage north. Go into the first room on the east and drop down the hole.

steps.text: Orc shamans right at the bottom (energy doesn't hurt them). Go north over the tiled floor and down.
steps.source: As soon as you drop down this hole, you will be surrounded by Orc Shamans. On this level, go north, facing more Orc Shamans. You will walk over a tile-floor area.

steps.text: Go north to the large pit (orc shamans, orc leaders, poison spiders) and down the hole on its north-east side.
steps.source: Head north and you will see a large pit and a Giant Spider waiting for you inside of it. The hole to get down is on the north-east side of the pit.

steps.text: Kill the giant spider (or grab the armor and run).
steps.source: Just go down the hole and kill the Giant Spider. Instead of killing the Giant Spider you can also put on Defensive Fighting mode, run to the body, grab the loot, and go back.

steps.text: The dark armor is in the dead body.
steps.source: You can find the Dark Armor inside a dead body on the ground.
